comparison.objective: Installs a second rack into a parallel gripper at the correct tooth phase; the candidate adjusts an already assembled gripper's maximum opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1898 requires rack insertion, gear-tooth meshing, phase alignment, and coupled jaw motion; the candidate requires hex-driver and jam-nut wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1898 checks rack seating, jaw centering, and at least 15 mm symmetric opening; the candidate checks a locked 90° limit retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both concern grippers and functional motion, but gear-phase assembly and threaded stop calibration test different mechanisms and manipulation abilities.

review_notes: Rack-pinion gripper assembly/even opening: compare ability, not gripper geometry.
